// Release-note partial for KOB-55177.
// Generated by Robot Ranch (Town Crier). Draft for docs-team review; not approved for publication.
// Suggested section: iOS device connections (deviceConnect).

- Sessions on iOS and iPadOS 27.2 devices connected directly to a Mac host now connect to the device's services. Previously, the device could refuse these connections, which prevented the session from starting. Devices running iOS 17 through 26, and devices connected through the GEM, are unaffected.
